title: Correct speed calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute v = F/(qB) = 5×10⁵ m/s.

title: Correct deflection direction
description: Essential: Student must state the proton deflects eastward.

title: Apply Lorentz force formula
description: Important: Student must use F = qvB for perpendicular motion.

title: Right-hand rule application
description: Important: Student must apply the right-hand rule correctly for a positive charge.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student shows unit analysis for v = F/(qB).

title: Sign error in force direction
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses negative sign for proton charge in force direction.

title: Wrong hand rule for positive charge
description: Pitfall: Student uses left-hand rule (for electrons) instead of right-hand rule.
